{{short description|Riemannian geometry mathematical problem}}
In [[Riemannian geometry]], a branch of [[mathematics]], the '''prescribed Ricci curvature problem''' is as follows: given a [[smooth manifold]] ''M'' and a symmetric 2-tensor ''h'', construct a [[Riemannian metric|metric]] on ''M'' whose [[Ricci curvature]] [[tensor]] equals ''h''.

* [[Prescribed scalar curvature problem]]
